name: Caleb Ticer

bio.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Ticer lists his occupation as retail manager, with about 10 years in retail across Senate District 6, some college at LCC and no prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Retail Manager Occupational Background: Approximately 10 years in retail across OR-SD6, beginning in sales with a major corporation and advancing into management

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 39

bio.statement: Ticer cites community work including facilitating donations that supplied more than 30,000 meals, hand-cleaning 21 miles of highway and connecting eight schools and four libraries with literacy grants.
bio.excerpt: helping facilitate donations that supplied more than 30,000 meals, helping clean 21 miles of highway by hand, and connecting eight schools and four libraries with corporate literacy grants.
